Why do Indian homes have steel rods on the roof? Why does Delhi have almost no skyscrapers? Why did a court order two finished towers in Noida demolished?

These are the questions we answer. How Indian property, rent and cities really work, in rupees, no jargon. Carpet area, RERA, CC, OC and stamp duty too.

Follow so the next explainer finds you. Educational, not advice. #realestateindia
